name: ATC_ROLLOVER_RULES
description: A table for storing the rollover rules.

columns.name: RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the rollover rule.

columns.name: RULE_PUID
columns.description: Indicates identifier of the rollover rule.

columns.name: PROD_OFFER_PRICE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key of the product offering price to which the rollover rule belongs.

columns.name: BALANCE_ELEMENT_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the balance element for which the rollover rule is applicable.

columns.name: MAX_NO_OF_ROLLOVER_CYCLES
columns.description: Indicates the maximum number of cycles for which rollover can be applied.

columns.name: MAX_ROLLOVER_AMT_PER_CYCLE
columns.description: Indicates the maximum rollover amount per rollover cycle.

columns.name: MAX_CUMULATIVE_ROLLOVER
columns.description: Indicates the maximum rollover amount that can be accumulated over the rollover cycles.

columns.name: ROLLOVER_UOM_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the unit of measure for which the rollover cycle limit is specified.

columns.name: GLID_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the GLID for the rollover charge.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
